user.title: Photography Events
user.description: Nothing here is required to start. Open-Meteo, iNaturalist and the wildflower hotlines need no account, so sunset scoring, meteor showers, whales and blooms all work straight away. The two API keys unlock rare birds and traffic-aware drive times, and can be added later.

data.enable_field_reports: Read the wildflower and autumn colour hotlines

data_description.max_drive_hours: The Can't Miss drive limit. Nothing further away reaches the main dashboard. The year planner still lists longer trips such as national parks.
data_description.sunset_score: How good the built-in local model's sky score must be before a sunset is considered. SunsetWx's own top tier is used instead when configured.
data_description.alert_score: Kept for existing automations on rows that were never assessed. The Can't Miss gate (significance, evidence, drive and safety) now decides what can turn the drop-everything sensor on.
data_description.ebird_api_key: Free and instant from ebird.org/api/keygen. Without it the bird category simply produces nothing.
data_description.google_api_key: Optional. Without it, drive times come from measured baselines and a calibrated distance estimate.
data_description.enable_field_reports: Scrapes three public pages once a day. Bloom timing depends on winter rainfall and cannot be computed, so these are the only real source for it.
data_description.nps_api_key: Free from nps.gov/subjects/developer. Used to warn you when a road or area in a park you were planning to visit is closed.
data_description.sunset_drive_hours: Sunsets are decided on the afternoon's forecast, so they get their own, much shorter radius. Nobody drives six hours for one, and listing them at that range turns the whole category into noise.
data_description.sunsetwx_client_id: Optional. A purpose-built sunrise/sunset quality forecast from sunsetwx.com (register there; choose the plan that fits your use). Without it the built-in model is used. Sunsets are assessed at home only.
data_description.sunsetwx_client_secret: Optional. Stored by Home Assistant; never shown on the card or written to logs.
